Title: VTES Hungarian Grand Prix in March 2015

Messages.Author: milcsix
Messages.Body:
EDIT: the date will be 20-21-22 March 2015.

Dear Methuselahs,

I am Milan Horvath, the organizer of VTES EC 2012 Budapest.
Please contribute to this poll!

I'm planning to organize a big international VTES competition in March of 2015 in Budapest.

It would be a 3-day event (Friday, Saturday, Sunday).
1st day: draft and/or storyline and/or Nation's cup
2nd day: Hungarian ECQ - EC qualifier
3rd day: VTES Hungarian Grand Prix (this is a constructed tournament also)

I've contanted VEKN Chairman Ginés Quiñonero Santiago and he is welcoming the idea.
The entrance fees and hotel accomodation prices would be similar to EC 2012

The question is:

would you attend to this event?

Thanks in advance for the answers: Milan
